preconditions.description: Both input strings must have at least one character.

postconditions.expression: all(c in str1 for c in return_value) and all(c in str2 for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the returned subsequence must exist in both input strings.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) >= len(lcs_candidate) for lcs_candidate in [s for s in subsequences(str1) if all(c in str2 for c in s)]
postconditions.description: The returned subsequence must be the longest possible common subsequence between the two input strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or all(return_value[i] == return_value[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i+1, len(return_value)) if i != j implies i < j)
postconditions.description: The returned subsequence must preserve the relative order of characters from both input strings.
